product_patterns.name: Command Center Dashboard
product_patterns.description: Ops/admin dashboards. Heavy monitoring, quick-scan KPIs, drill-down tables.
layout_structure: Sticky topbar: logo + nav + user menu
Filter toolbar: date range, status filter, export button (full width)
KPI grid: 4 cards full-width (desktop) → 2 (tablet) → 1 (mobile)
Chart row: primary chart 60% + activity feed 40%
Data table: full-width, sortable, paginated, responsive to 1-column on mobile
product_patterns.grid_system: 12-column, 16px gutter, max-width 1400px (can go wider for data-dense dashboards)
component_inventory: Filterable data table with row actions

responsive_breakpoints.desktop_1280: 4-column KPI grid, chart 60/40 split, full table
responsive_breakpoints.tablet_768: 2-column KPI grid, full-width chart, scrollable table
responsive_breakpoints.mobile_375: 1-column KPI grid, stacked charts, single-column table

state_machine: Loading: skeleton cards + shimmer table rows
Empty: 'No data for this period' + optional CTA
Error: banner with retry + partial data if available
product_patterns.motion_spec: Staggered KPI entrance (50ms offset), chart SVG path draw on load, table row hover bg transition
anti_patterns: Mixed time periods in same view (pick one period)

product_patterns.name: Marketing Hero + Features + Social Proof
product_patterns.description: Landing pages, growth, conversion-focused. Hero hook, feature cards, testimonials, CTA.
layout_structure: Hero section: full-width background image or gradient, centered headline + subheadline + CTA button (40vh min)
Features grid: 3–4 cards with icons, headline, description (2 columns on tablet, 1 on mobile)
Social proof: testimonials carousel or static cards (3–5 quotes)
CTA section: 'Ready to get started?' + primary button + optional secondary link
Footer: links, copyright, privacy policy

hero_specifics.headline: Primary font, 3–4× body size, ≤12 words
hero_specifics.background: Hero gradient or image (16:9 aspect, optimize for mobile)

component_inventory: Feature card with icon + headline + description
Testimonial quote card (quote + author avatar + name + role)
CTA button (primary color, full-width on mobile)

responsive_breakpoints.tablet_768: 2-column feature grid, 2-column testimonials, hero text smaller
responsive_breakpoints.mobile_375: 1-column everything, hero headline ≥ 24px, CTA full-width button

anti_patterns: Stock photos (use real product screenshots or illustrations)
Thin light typefaces at small sizes (poor readability)

product_patterns.name: Analytics Dashboard (Period Comparison)
product_patterns.description: Reporting dashboards. Period selector, KPIs with comparison, charts, drill-down table.
layout_structure: Toolbar: period selector (Last 7d / Last 30d / Custom), comparison toggle (YoY / MoM), export CSV
KPI row: 3–4 cards with value + % change + trend sparkline
Charts: 2×2 grid or 1×3 depending on number of metrics
Table: transactions/events with full record detail, searchable, sortable, paginated
Footer: date range in UTC, data last refreshed timestamp
product_patterns.comparison_visual: KPI delta: +12% or -3% with up/down arrow, background tint (green/red)
component_inventory: Period selector dropdown + custom range picker
Data table with column sort + filter

responsive_breakpoints.desktop_1280: 4 KPI cards, 2×2 chart grid, full-width table
responsive_breakpoints.tablet_768: 2 KPI cards, 1×2 chart grid, scrollable table
responsive_breakpoints.mobile_375: 1 KPI per row (stacked), charts full-width, single-column table

anti_patterns: Same scale for all charts (normalize by metric)

product_patterns.name: Multi-Step Form / Checkout
product_patterns.description: Conversion forms. Progress indicator, inline validation, error recovery, reassurance.
layout_structure: Progress indicator: steps 1-2-3 with current step highlighted (optional on mobile)
Form section: single step, headline + description
Form fields: clear labels above inputs, validation messages inline
CTA buttons: [Back] [Next] or [Back] [Submit]
Trust badges: SSL lock, refund guarantee, privacy policy link (bottom)

field_layout.label: Above input, required asterisk if needed, 14px
field_layout.helper_text: Below input, 12px, muted color, optional tips
field_layout.error_message: Below input, red + ✕ icon + plain language

component_inventory: CTA button (primary full-width on mobile, side-by-side on desktop)

responsive_breakpoints.desktop_1280: Form in center column 50%, progress on left or top
responsive_breakpoints.tablet_768: Full-width form, progress as horizontal steps
responsive_breakpoints.mobile_375: Full-width form, progress steps stacked or hidden

state_transitions: Field error: border red + ✕ + message appears
Field filled: optional checkmark in corner (subtle)
anti_patterns: Inline validation before user leaves field (annoying)
No error recovery help (generic error code)

product_patterns.name: Data Table (Dense, Sortable, Searchable)
product_patterns.description: Admin interfaces, analytics. Dense table with sort, filter, pagination, row actions.
layout_structure: Toolbar: search box + column filter + bulk actions
Table: headers with sort arrows, rows with selection checkbox + row data + action menu
Pagination: page info (1–20 of 1000) + next/prev + page size selector
Selection state: highlighted row(s), bulk action button (delete, export, etc.)
product_patterns.grid_system: Full-width table with fixed columns (checkbox, ID) and scrollable data columns (mobile), max-width 1400px

column_spec.header: 12px uppercase, bold, primary color, sort arrow on hover

component_inventory: Sortable table header with up/down arrow

responsive_breakpoints.desktop_1280: Full table, all columns visible, no horizontal scroll
responsive_breakpoints.tablet_768: Hide tertiary columns, action menu into drawer or tooltip
responsive_breakpoints.mobile_375: Card view (each row becomes a card), swipe for actions

interaction_spec.sort: Click header → sort ASC → click again → sort DESC → 3rd click → clear sort
interaction_spec.select: Checkbox toggles row highlight + enables bulk actions
interaction_spec.row_hover: Slight bg-color transition, action menu visible

anti_patterns: Too many columns (>8 is dense, use card view on mobile)

product_patterns.name: Modal / Dialog (Overlay, Focused Task)
product_patterns.description: Confirmation dialogs, forms in overlays. Focused task, clear primary action, escape to close.
layout_structure: Backdrop: semi-transparent overlay, click outside to close (optional)
Modal card: centered, shadow elevation, max-width 480px or 90vw on mobile
Header: headline + optional subtext + close button (X)
Body: content (form, confirmation message, details)
Footer: action buttons, right-aligned ([Cancel] [Primary Action])
product_patterns.grid_system: Fixed max-width or 90vw on mobile, centered via flexbox
product_patterns.animation: Scale up 0.96→1 + opacity 0→1 (spring, 250ms), Escape key or click outside closes
state_machine: Open: scale-up animation, focus trap active
Content: form interactions, button hover/active states
Close: scale-down animation, focus returned to trigger element
anti_patterns: Modal can't close (no X button, no Escape key)
Scroll inside modal while backdrop scrolls (lock body scroll)
Modal action buttons outside visible area (cut off on small phones)
